name: oil-motion
tagline: Create smooth, responsive interactive web animations
description: oil-motion is a library for creating smooth, responsive interactive web animations. It focuses on making motion feel natural on the web — easing, timing, and responsiveness that respect the user's device and interaction — without the boilerplate of lower-level animation APIs. It is a Python-flavored project with a growing community, aimed at developers who want polished motion in their interfaces.
highlights: Smooth, responsive animation primitives for the web
Interaction-aware motion that respects the device
Low boilerplate compared to raw animation APIs
867 stars in days shows demand for modern motion tooling
curatorNote: Web motion is having a renaissance, and oil-motion's focus on smooth, responsive, interaction-aware animation fills a real gap between raw APIs and heavy frameworks.
